info.about: Dragon Warrior Monsters 2, known in Japan as Dragon Quest Monsters 2 , is a role-playing video game published by Enix for the Game Boy Color. It is the second Dragon Warrior Monsters game for the Game Boy Color and features two different versions of the same game, Cobi's Journey and Tara's Adventure.
info.why: Enix released both Monsters 2 cartridges in North America in September 2001, after the Game Boy Advance had launched, so the print runs were short.
